articleBlocks: Today's puzzle features a collection of powerful natural landmarks that have shaped both geography and human history. As I examined Mauna Loa and Mount Fuji, the pattern became clearer, though some solvers might initially focus on mountains rather than their more specific classification. Looking at Eyjafjallajökull, I remembered its famous 2010 eruption that disrupted European air travel. The presence of Mauna Loa made me consider Hawaiian geography, but its volcanic nature stood out more prominently. When I saw Mount Fuji, Japan's iconic volcanic peak, the pattern became unmistakable. Krakatoa's infamous 1883 eruption and Vesuvius's destruction of Pompeii confirmed we were dealing with volcanoes. I was struck by how each of these formations has dramatically impacted human history through their explosive activity.
